position: AI Engineer · Engineering Lead, AI for Private Equity
details: I lead engineering for Exadel's AI practice for private equity: architecture, development, quality, and the technical calls. I'm embedded with a global PE firm's deal teams and leadership, and Exadel sells what we build there to other PE firms.

I wrote the engineering standards the team builds by: how we use AI coding tools, how we write and review code, how we collect requirements, and how we work with stakeholders. I also interview our AI engineer and FDE candidates, and I designed Exadel's first AI Advisory Lab, where ~20 mostly non-technical consultants built working prototypes with Claude Code in 75 minutes.

**Cascades:** drafts investment-committee memos straight from a deal's data room, with every claim traced back to its source document. It takes a first draft from ~4 weeks to a few hours. (Claude Agent SDK, Postgres, Azure)

**Appalachia:** turns messy, unstructured financial files into structured data and weekly, monthly and quarterly reports across 28 portfolio companies. That's 2,000+ reports a year nobody writes by hand anymore, plus a growing base of structured data the system keeps learning from.
Built a redaction tool for investor tax documents (K-1s, 1042-S, capital calls) so fund accounting can safely use AI on them. Every redaction is deterministic, with no external API calls.
Built an agent that learns how the firm's leaders think from their meeting transcripts, so deal teams hear leadership's questions before the IC meeting instead of during it.

**Project Portfolio Platform:** took it from idea to MVP in about two months, then to full production two months later. It cut project documentation from a month to 2 to 3 days (20 to 40 hours saved per document) and is now the standard process across Exadel's delivery engineering org, thousands of engineers strong.
Built a thread-safe logging and observability system for accounts-receivable invoicing. Recovery from invoice failures went from 74 minutes to under 60 seconds on a $40M-a-year integration.
Worked on the MBO and PwC API integration: real-time updates over Solace, New Relic dashboards, and the NRQL queries and runbooks the team used to hunt down bad records.
Led a dynamic pricing tool that automates rate calculations and invoice generation around each client's rules.
Built a customer-support bot on Dialogflow, live on seven web pages and wired to two MySQL databases: one to answer questions, one to log new ones for the team.
It handled ~4,700 conversations a day and cut wait times by 70% and support costs by 45%. It was my first time watching real users talk to something I built.
Resident Assistant for three years, which is basically client support with a 2 AM SLA.
Co-founder and VP of the Google Developer Student Club: workshops and competitive coding events.
Research Director of the Computer Science Society: ran the weekly tech talks and a year-long research project.
IT Service Desk (2021 to 2024), where I learned to explain tech to people who don't care how it works, just that it works.
